meta.description: One skeleton per page type. The planner fills these from real SERP evidence and the writer follows the result, which is what stops thirty pages in a batch sharing one shape. Fixed on purpose: free-form structure per page cannot be templated, cannot be taught to someone else, and drifts across a batch.
meta.placeholders: {primary} is the primary keyword verbatim. {topic} is the same phrase with its leading stem removed (how to, what is, best), for headings that supply their own. {product} the site name, {competitor} the named rival. Exactly ONE heading per template carries the keyword: repeating it in every H2 is stuffing and reads like a machine wrote it.
meta.editing: Add or change a template here rather than letting a model improvise one. If a SERP genuinely needs a shape none of these cover, that is a signal to add a type deliberately, not to freestyle.
meta.hero_concept: Art direction for the hero, per page type. Written as a SCENE, because an image model given a restated keyword returns stock-shaped filler, and given an SEO gap ('no page runs an FAQ') returns nothing usable at all.

how_to_guide.opening: Open on the specific moment the reader is in. Two sentences, then answer. No definition first.

sections.heading: Why this is harder than it sounds
sections.purpose: Answer the query fast and earn trust without lecturing.

sections.heading: What it actually looks like
sections.purpose: Recognition. The reader should feel described.

sections.heading: The step people skip
sections.purpose: The overlooked move, and the natural place the product fits without a pitch.

sections.heading: When this is not the real problem
sections.purpose: Concede honestly. Trust is won here.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
sections.purpose: Capture the People Also Ask variants, marked up as FAQPage.

sections.purpose: Question variants from the SERP.

sections.heading: Pricing, honestly

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
sections.purpose: The comparison questions people actually ask.

comparison.hero_concept: two ways of handling {topic} weighed against each other on a balance

sections.purpose: Required. It is the section that makes the rest believable.

sections.heading: The alternatives

sections.purpose: Switching questions: migration, pricing, data.
